motivation: Evaluate whether independently dated macrofossil/pollen records could constrain future 21ka host plant occupancy models, rather than result-driven retuning of a negative current-climate host-identity comparison.

Neotoma.request_method: exact taxon name. No wildcard genus expansion for claims.

selection_rule: Source-only 12 evenly spaced positions among 416 source modelled WCVP accepted IDs in ascending ID plus 3 labeled temperate woody technical API query controls; neither is representative of global host fossil coverage.
status_rules: No occurrence returned / API timeout must be recorded as missing source info, NOT species absent during LGM
Neotoma taxon genus-only pollen or fossil identifications cannot be imputed to exact WCVP species
Ageold/ageyoung API query may filter dataset date spans rather than directly observed calibrated sample age: do NOT claim 18-24ka confirmed occurrences from metadata alone

Any returned record requires sample chronology, taxon taxonomic precision, site coordinates, dataset ID, depositional/proxy type and collection provenance review before ancient plant occupancy evidence
Do not use fossil observation availability to select insects or alter prior glacial host patch null family; source access test only
Earlier TTF host-identity v0.5 and chocho real-alt-plant v0.8 remain negative/not-positively-supported and frozen
No source genetics or modern insect response accessed
